title: Coaxial capacitor off the grid: cut-cell held edges (electrostatics, conformal boundaries, analytic)
description:
Coax cross-section whose circles lie off the mesh: core (radius a) held at V0 and shield (every point with r > b) at 0 V by terminals, fill eps_fill; the axis is offset from every cell vertex and a, b are no multiples of the cell, so each mesh sees other sub-cell cuts. solver_defaults.conformal_boundaries is on: each free cell next to a terminal links to the drawn circle at its true distance (cut-cell held edges, Shortley-Weller conductance) instead of the staircased cell face. The sweep refines dx_cell (a / dx ~ 7.8, 15.6, 31.2).
Analytic: V = V0 ln(b/r)/ln(b/a), C' = 2 pi eps0 eps_fill/ln(b/a) per m of depth.
Derived values tab: C_per_m (core charge / voltage) and Q_shield (= -C' V0) with their references; expect a few 1e-3 at the coarsest mesh, falling roughly 4x per refinement (second order). Switch Follow curved walls off (Solvers node) to compare: the staircase gives errors of ~1-3 % that jump irregularly with the mesh.
Sweep tab: C_per_m vs dx_cell with the dashed analytic value.
Line profile tab (finest mesh): V_radial along the ray y = y_c from the axis to the domain edge against the log profile (held cells read V0 / 0, as the clamped analytic curve does at their centres); expect ~1e-3 of V0.
Staircased twin: coax_capacitor_electrostatics.

parameters.name: V0
parameters.description: core voltage [V]; the shield is held at 0 V

parameters.name: a
parameters.description: core (inner conductor) radius, off the cell edges

parameters.name: b
parameters.description: shield (outer conductor) inner radius, off the cell edges

parameters.name: eps_fill
parameters.description: static relative permittivity of the fill (PTFE ~2.1)

parameters.name: L_box
parameters.description: domain side; the shield fills every cell with r > b

parameters.name: x_c
parameters.description: axis x, off the cell vertices

parameters.name: y_c
parameters.description: axis y, off the cell vertices

analytic_curves.name: V_radial
analytic_curves.expression: V0*log(b/min(max(hypot(x - x_c, y - y_c), a), b))/log(b/a)
